excerpt: Why Multilingual Talent Matters and How to Source It Efficiently in Canada Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. In Canada’s diverse and globally connected economy, multilingual talent is more than a “nice-to-have” skill. It is a strategic advantage that can open new markets, improve customer relationships, and foster workplace inclusion. For employers competing in industries like hospitality, healthcare, customer service, trade, and technology, the ability to recruit and retain employees who can communicate in multiple languages can be the difference between stagnation and growth.
